name: A2_end_frame
edit_prompt: Edit only the paint inside the can: the three separate color blobs are now fully mixed into one perfectly uniform flat color — a single solid muted teal-green, completely even, no swirls, no streaks, no traces of original colors, no marble pattern. Flat smooth paint surface like fresh house paint. The wooden stir stick is still submerged in the paint, hand still gripping it. Everything else unchanged — same can, same hand position, same table, same lighting, same camera angle.
